GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ExtraireCle(pnd As NotesDocument, pa_Champs() As String, pa_Formats() As String) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_NoChamp As Variant Dim a_Cle As Variant Dim i As Integer
a_NoChamp = xVarArray(pnd, "SILSX_Cle") If Isarray(a_NoChamp) Then Redim a_Cle(Ubound(a_NoChamp)) As Variant For i = 0 To Ubound(a_NoChamp) a_Cle(i) = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(pa_Champs(a_NoChamp(i)), pa_Formats(a_NoChamp(i))) Next SILSX_ExtraireCle = a_Cle Else SILSX_ExtraireCle = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(pa_Champs(a_NoChamp), pa_Formats(a_NoChamp)) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ExtraireLong(Byval p_NomZone As String) As Long ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de nombre (long) On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSX_ExtraireLong = 0
Dim v_lcf As LCField
Set v_lcf = glcfl_SILSX.Lookup(p_NomZone) SILSX_ExtraireLong = v_lcf.GetInt(1) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees(Byval p_NomImportation As String, p_SQLWhere As String, pndb As NotesDatabase, _ pndc_Donnees As NotesDocumentCollection) As Boolean ' Cette fonction retourne les données d'un fichier db2 dans un tableau On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_SILSX As NotesDocument Dim v_SQLWhere As String Dim ni_Operations As Notesitem Dim a_Champs As Variant Dim a_Formats As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim a_CleLSX As Variant Dim v_Valeur As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim v As Variant Dim v_ValeurErreur As String
' Initialisations SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees = False v_ValeurErreur = p_NomImportation Set nv = pndb.GetView("V_AdmT") Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey("** BiDoN **", True) Set pndc_Donnees = ndc
' Extraire le document des parametres Set nd_SILSX = xndSILSX(p_NomImportation, True) If nd_SILSX Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_ImporterCollection", "") <> "1" Then Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_TypeConnection", "db2"), _ xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomServeur", ""), xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomUsager", ""), _ xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_MotPasse", ""), xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Journalisation", "1") = "0") Then ' Ouvrir le fichier d'importation v_SQLWhere = xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLWhere", "") If p_SQLWhere <> "" Then If v_SQLWhere = "" Then v_SQLWhere = p_SQLWhere Else v_SQLWhere = "(" & v_SQLWhere & ") and (" & p_SQLWhere & ")" End If End If If SILSX_OuvrirFichier(xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomFichier", ""), _ v_SQLWhere, xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLOrderBy", ""), v_NbSel) Then If v_NbSel <> 0 Then ' Initialisations SILSX Set ni_Operations = nd_SILSX.Getfirstitem("SILSX_Operations") a_Champs = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Champs") a_Formats = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Formats") a_Items = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Items") Set nv = pndb.Getview(xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomVue", "")) If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les enregistrements Do While SILSX_LireEnregistrement() v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_Maj = False
a_CleLSX = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Cle") Redim a_Cle(Ubound(a_CleLSX)) As Variant For i = 0 To Ubound(a_CleLSX) a_Cle(i) = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(a_CleLSX(i)), a_Formats(a_CleLSX(i))) Next Set nd = nv.Getdocumentbykey(a_Cle, True) ' Nouveau document ' --------------------------- If nd Is Nothing Then If ni_Operations.Contains("A") Then Set nd = New NotesDocument(pndb) nd.Form = xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomMasque", "")
nd.HistoDI = Now nd.HistoUI = ns.Username nd.HistoTI = "A"
v_Maj = True End If
' Document existant ' -------------------------- Elseif ni_Operations.Contains("M") Then nd.HistoDI = Now nd.HistoUI = ns.Username nd.HistoTI = "M"
v_Maj = True End If
' Mise à jour des items ' ------------------------------ If v_Maj Then v_Maj = nd.IsNewNote
For i = Lbound(a_Champs) To Ubound(a_Champs) v_ValeurErreur = a_Champs(i) If i > Ubound(a_Formats) Then v_Valeur = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), "") Else v_Valeur = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), a_Formats(i)) End If
If Cstr(v_Valeur) <> xVarImplode(nd, a_Items(i), ";") Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue(a_Items(i), v_Valeur) v_Maj = True End If Next
If v_Maj Then ' Appliquer les formules If nd.IsNewNote Then v = xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_FormuleAjout", "") Else v = xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_FormuleModification", "") End If If v <> "" Then v = Evaluate(v, nd) End If
' Compute with form Call nd.Computewithform(True, False)
' Sauvegarder le nouveau document Call nd.Save(True, True)
Call ndc.AddDocument(nd) End If End If Loop End If End If
Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() End If
Set pndc_Donnees = ndc SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), v_ValeurErreur, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ExtraireValeur(p_NomChamp As String, p_Format As String) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSX_ExtraireValeur = ""
Select Case Ucase(p_Format) Case "D": ' Double = 0.00 SILSX_ExtraireValeur = SILSX_ExtraireDouble(p_NomChamp) Case "L": ' Double = 0 SILSX_ExtraireValeur = SILSX_ExtraireLong(p_NomChamp) Case "CYMD", "DMY", "MDY", "YMD": ' Date SILSX_ExtraireValeur = SILSX_ExtraireDate(p_NomChamp, p_Format) Case Else: ' String SILSX_ExtraireValeur = SILSX_ExtraireString(p_NomChamp) End Select Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_DernierJourDuMois(p_Annee As Integer, p_Mois As Integer) As Integer On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSX_DernierJourDuMois = 0
' Premier jour du mois suivant Dim v_Jour As New NotesDateTime("") v_Jour.LSLocalTime = Datenumber(p_Annee, p_Mois, 1) Call v_Jour.SetAnyTime Call v_Jour.AdjustMonth(1)
' Dernière journée du mois Call v_Jour.AdjustDay(-1) SILSX_DernierJourDuMois = Day(v_Jour.LSLocalTime) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_aImporterDonnees(Byval p_NomImportation As String, pa_Donnees As Variant) As Boolean ' Cette fonction retourne les données d'un fichier db2 dans un tableau On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SILSX As NotesDocument Dim a_Champs As Variant Dim a_Formats As Variant Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Initialisations SILSX_aImporterDonnees = False pa_Donnees = ""
' Extraire le document des parametres Set nd_SILSX = xndSILSX(p_NomImportation, True) If nd_SILSX Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir la connexion au serveur de base de données If SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_TypeConnection", "db2"), _ xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomServeur", ""), xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomUsager", ""), _ xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_MotPasse", ""), xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Journalisation", "1") = "0") Then ' Ouvrir le fichier d'importation If SILSX_OuvrirFichier(xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_NomFichier", ""), _ xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLWhere", ""), xVar(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_SQLOrderBy", ""), v_NbSel) Then If v_NbSel <> 0 Then a_Champs = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Champs") a_Formats = xVarArray(nd_SILSX, "SILSX_Formats") Redim a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), 100) As Variant
' Boucler sur tous les enregistrements Do While SILSX_LireEnregistrement() v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 If v_NbLus > Ubound(a_Donnees, 2) Then Redim Preserve a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), Ubound(a_Donnees, 2) + 100) As Variant End If
For i = Lbound(a_Champs) To Ubound(a_Champs) If i > Ubound(a_Formats) Then a_Donnees(i, v_NbLus - 1) = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), "") Else a_Donnees(i, v_NbLus - 1) = SILSX_ExtraireValeur(a_Champs(i), a_Formats(i)) End If Next Loop
If v_NbLus > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_Donnees(Ubound(a_Champs), v_NbLus - 1) As Variant Redim a_Donnees(v_NbLus - 1, Ubound(a_Champs)) As Variant For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Champs) For j = 1 To v_NbLus a_Donnees(j - 1, i) = a_Donnees(i, j - 1) Next Next End If End If End If
Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() End If
SILSX_aImporterDonnees = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SILSX_FermerConnexion() Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_OuvrirConnexion(Byval p_TypeConnection As String, Byval p_NomServeur As String, _ Byval p_NomUsager As String, Byval p_MotPasse As String, p_NoJournal As Boolean) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir la connexion avec le serveur ' Type de connection : db2, odbc2 On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSX_OuvrirConnexion = False
Set glcc_SILSX = New LCConnection(p_TypeConnection) Select Case p_TypeConnection Case "db2": glcc_SILSX.Database = p_NomServeur Case Else: glcc_SILSX.Server = p_NomServeur End Select glcc_SILSX.UserID = p_NomUsager glcc_SILSX.Password = p_MotPasse
If p_NoJournal Then Call glcc_SILSX.SetPropertyBoolean(4,True) End If
' Ouvrir la connection glcc_SILSX.Connect SILSX_OuvrirConnexion = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_FermerConnexion As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet de fermer la connexion avec le serveur On Error Goto GererErreur
SILSX_FermerConnexion = False
glcc_SILSX.Disconnect SILSX_FermerConnexion = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_ExtraireDate(Byval p_NomZone As String, Byval p_FormatDate As String) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une zone de l'enregistrement courant sous forme de date On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As String Dim v_Annee As Integer Dim v_Mois As Integer Dim v_Jour As Integer
If p_FormatDate = "CYMD" Then v_Date = Right("00000000" + SILSX_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 8) v_Annee = Cint(Left(v_Date, 4)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 5, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) Else v_Date = Right("000000" + SILSX_ExtraireString(p_NomZone), 6) Select Case p_FormatDate Case "DMY" : v_Annee = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) Case "MDY" : v_Annee = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) Case "YMD" : v_Annee = Cint(Left(v_Date, 2)) v_Mois = Cint(Mid(v_Date, 3, 2)) v_Jour = Cint(Right(v_Date, 2)) Case Else : v_Mois = 0 End Select End If
If v_Annee = 0 Or v_Mois < 1 Or v_Mois > 12 Then ' Mois invalide, retourner NULL SILSX_ExtraireDate = Null Else If v_Jour < 1 Or v_Jour > SILSX_DernierJourDuMois(v_Annee, v_Mois) Then ' Jour invalide, retourner NULL SILSX_ExtraireDate = Null Else SILSX_ExtraireDate = Datenumber(v_Annee, v_Mois, v_Jour) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SILSX_OuvrirFichier(Byval p_NomTable As String, Byval p_SQLWhere As String, Byval p_SQLOrderBy As String, _ p_NbEnregistrements As Long) As Boolean ' Cette fonction permet d'ouvrir un fichier sur le serveur On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_SQLSelect As String
SILSX_OuvrirFichier = False
Set glcfl_SILSX = New LCFieldList v_SQLSelect = "SELECT * FROM " + p_NomTable If Len(p_SQLWhere) > 0 Then v_SQLSelect = v_SQLSelect + " WHERE " + p_SQLWhere End If If Len(p_SQLOrderBy) > 0 Then v_SQLSelect = v_SQLSelect + " ORDER BY " + p_SQLOrderBy End If Print v_SQLSelect
p_NbEnregistrements = glcc_SILSX.Execute(v_SQLSelect, glcfl_SILSX) SILSX_OuvrirFichier = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SILSX, gc_Element_SILSX, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire se trouvent dans la base de documents courante. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être x_SILSX ou SILSX est le type de document. ' 2. Inscrire le nom de l'item qui contient la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de SILSX par l'identifiant du type de document. Les subs seront ' automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xSILSX Dim gns_xSILSX As Notessession Dim gndb_xSILSX As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_xSILSX As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_xSILSX As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomItemCle_xSILSX = "SILSX_Nom" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVue_xSILSX = "V_SILSX20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche
Sub Initialisation_xSILSX ' Initialisation des variables globales If gns_xSILSX Is Nothing Then Set gns_xSILSX = New Notessession Set gndb_xSILSX = gns_xSILSX.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function xndSILSX(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call Initialisation_xSILSX
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCle_xSILSX, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSILSX, gc_NomVue_xSILSX, gnv_xSILSX, gnd_xSILSX)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xndSILSX = gnd_xSILSX End Function

Function xVarSILSX(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xVarSILSX = xVar(xndSILSX(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SDSC_Image" Use "SDSC_Proposition" Use "SDSC_BonsTravail" Use "SI_DatabaseScript" Use "wsc_SDSC2" Use "x_SDSPP" Use "x_SDSP" Use "x_SDSBB" Use "x_GDK" Use "SI_MSWord"

Dim gnuiws_FProp As NotesUIWorkspace Dim gnuid_FProp As NotesUIDocument Dim gnd_FProp As NotesDocument

Sub FProp_acRefuser '--------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet au directeur d'accepter la proposition. '--------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then ' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
' Accepter la proposition If SDSPP_AssignerStatut(gnd_FProp, "12", True, "", "") Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close End If

Sub Fprop_AjouterDestinataires (p_type As String, p_No As String, p_To As Variant, p_CC As Variant)
' -------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet construire les champs DestinatiresA et FacturationCC. ' --------------------------------------------------------
Dim v_DestinatairesA As Variant Dim v_DestinatairesCC As Variant
If p_type = "Equipe" Then v_DestinatairesA = xSIRR_xVarEqui(p_No, "Equi_DestFacturation", "", True) v_DestinatairesCC = xSIRR_xVarEqui(p_No, "Equi_CCFacturation", "", True) Else
v_DestinatairesA = xSIRR_xVarRepr(p_No, "Repr_DestFacturation", "", True) v_DestinatairesCC = xSIRR_xVarRepr(p_No, "Repr_CCFacturation", "", True)
End If
'Maj To If Not IsArray(v_DestinatairesA) Then v_DestinatairesA = Evaluate(|"| & v_DestinatairesA & |"|) End If
If v_DestinatairesA(0) <> "" Then p_to = ArrayAppend (p_To, v_DestinatairesA) End If
'Maj CC If Not IsArray(v_DestinatairesCC) Then v_DestinatairesCC = Evaluate(|"| & v_DestinatairesCC & |"|) End If
If v_DestinatairesCC(0) <> "" Then p_CC = ArrayAppend (p_CC, v_DestinatairesCC) End If
End Sub

Sub FProp_acChangerRepresentant ' -------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de changer le représentant de la proposition. ' -------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur

' Demander le nouveau représentant
Set ndc = gnuiws_FProp.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_xSIRR.Server, gndb_xSIRR.Filepath, "V_Repr16", _ "Sales Rep. Selection", "Select the sales rep. of the proposal.", "1") If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Rep = ndc.GetFirstDocument
' Mettre à jour la proposition If SDSPP_ChangerRepresentant(gnd_FProp, nd_Rep) Then 'If "" Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = gnuiws_FProp.EditDocument(True, gnd_FProp) Delete gnuid_FProp Set gnuid_FProp = nuid Set gnd_FProp = gnuid_FProp.Document Call gnd_FProp.RemoveItem("SaveOptions") Else Print "Opération annulée" End If End If

Sub FProp_acImporterFactures On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim a_NoFacture As Variant Dim a_NoFactureDevise As Variant Dim vwsc_SDSC2 As New Cl_SDSCommissionsII Dim v_Resultats As String Dim a_Resultats As Variant
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim k As Integer Dim v_MSG As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Valider / Sauvegarder le document On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur
' Demander les numéros de facture à importer Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) If gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Fact", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Importation de factures", _ nd_DB, True, False, False) Then j = 0 k = 0 a_NoFacture = xVarArray(nd_DB, "DB_NoFacture")
v_Resultats = vwsc_SDSC2.ImporterFactures(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), Implode(a_NoFacture, ";")) a_Resultats = Split(v_Resultats, ";")
ReDim a_ErrNoFactureDevise(UBound(a_NoFacture)) As String ReDim a_ErrNoFacture(UBound(a_NoFacture)) As String
For i = LBound(a_Resultats) To UBound(a_Resultats) Select Case a_Resultats(i) Case "0" ' pas d'erreur
Case "1" ' Erreur devise a_ErrNoFactureDevise(j) = a_NoFacture(i) j = j + 1 Case Else ' Erreur générale (2) a_ErrNoFacture(k) = a_NoFacture(i) k = k + 1 End Select Next
If j > 0 Then ReDim Preserve a_ErrNoFactureDevise(j - 1) As String ' La facture 99999 n'a pas été importée car sa devise est différente de celle de la proposition. v_MSG = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 0, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFactureDevise, ", ")) End If If k > 0 Then ReDim Preserve a_ErrNoFacture(k - 1) As String If v_MSG = "" Then ' Les factures suivantes n'ont pas été importées : " & Implode(a_NoFacture, ", ") v_MSG = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 2, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFacture, ", ")) Else ' "Les factures suivantes n'ont pas été importées : " & Implode(a_NoFacture, ", "), "Importation de factures" v_MSG = v_MSG & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 2, "", Implode(a_ErrNoFacture, ", ")) End If End If
' Rafraichir le document On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur
' Afficher le message d'erreur If v_MSG <> "" Then MessageBox v_MSG, 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCC", 1, "", "") End If
Call gnuid_FProp.Refresh End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FProp_acImprimer(p_Destinataire As String, p_Action As String, p_CheminPDF As String) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'imprimer les commissions de la proposition (avec succursales et produits). ' ' Paramètres: ' p_Destinataire : "D" = Directeur, "R" = Représentant ' p_Action : "P" = Imprimer, "E" = Exporter dans un document PDF '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_CheminAccesTemp As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_CheminRTF As String Dim v_CheminPDF As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur End If
' Copier la proposition dans un document temporaire Set nd_Temp = gnd_FProp.CopyToDatabase(gndb_FProp)
' Définir la langue d'impression If p_Destinataire = "D" Then v_Langue = "FR" ' Directeur toujours en français nd_Temp.Prop_AfficherCommDir = "1"
Else v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(CStr(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NoRepresentant", "")), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) End If
nd_Temp.Form = "F_Prop3" & v_Langue nd_Temp.Form_Destinataire = p_Destinataire nd_Temp.Form_Action = p_Action nd_Temp.Form_Langue = v_Langue
' DocumentUniqueID de la proposition nd_Temp.Prop_Unid = CStr(gnd_FProp.UniversalId)
' Ajouter l'image de la succursale à la proposition Call SDSCIm_GenererSuccursales(nd_Temp)
If p_Action = "E" Then v_CheminAccesTemp = Environ("Temp") & "\SDSC3" On Error 75 Resume Next MkDir v_CheminAccesTemp v_CheminAccesTemp = v_CheminAccesTemp & "\" v_NomFichier = StrLeft(xVar(gnd_FProp, "Prop_NbPropositionTXT", ""), ".") & "_" & xUnique v_CheminRTF = v_CheminAccesTemp & v_NomFichier & ".rtf" v_CheminPDF = v_CheminAccesTemp & v_NomFichier & ".pdf"
nd_Temp.Form_CheminRTF = v_CheminRTF End If
Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False)
' Pour tester - Ouvre le document TEMP ******************************** DEBUG ********************************** nd_Temp.Form_Debug = "1"
' Imprimer la propositions Call gnuiws_FProp.EditDocument(False, nd_Temp)
If p_Action = "E" Then If SIMW_DemarrerWord(False) Then If SIMW_OuvrirDocument(v_CheminRTF) Then If SIMW_EnregistrerDocumentPDF(False, v_CheminPDF) Then p_CheminPDF = v_CheminPDF
End If
Call SIMW_FermerDocument End If
Call SIMW_FermerWord End If Kill v_CheminRTF End If
' Mettre le document temporaire dans la corbeille Call SIDS_CorbeilleDocument(nd_Temp, "", "")
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FProp_acImprimerPDF (p_Destinataire As String) ' ----------------------------- ' Le script permet d'imprimer . ' ----------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_SICT As NotesDocument Dim ndb_SITmp As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nd_temp As NotesDocument
Dim nrtitem As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrt_body As NotesRichTextItem
Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject Dim na As NotesAgent
Dim v_docValide As Boolean Dim v_CheminPDF As String Dim v_NoRepresentant As String Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_Message As String Dim v_Etapefmt As String Dim v_Etape As String Dim v_NoEquipe As String Dim v_EquipeTypeMembres As String Dim v_NoMessage As Integer
Dim v_DestinataireA As Variant Dim v_DestinataireCC As Variant Dim v_FacturationCC As Variant
Dim v_To As Variant Dim v_CC As Variant Dim v_etapeDesc As String
Call FProp_Initialisations Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
v_docValide = True
Set nd = gnuiws_FProp.CurrentDocument.Document Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp)
Set ndb_SITmp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") Set nd_temp = New NotesDocument(ndb_SITmp)
nd_DB.Destinataire = p_Destinataire nd_DB.Cle = xVar(nd, "Cle", "") nd_DB.Prop_NoProposition = xVar(nd, "Prop_NoProposition", "") nd_DB.Prop_Type = xVar(nd, "Prop_Type", "")
' ----- Validations If Not gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Mesg", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Message courriel", nd_DB, True, False, False) Then v_docValide = False Call gnuiws_FProp.ViewRefresh Exit Sub End If
v_Message = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Message", "") v_Etape = xVar(nd_DB, "Mesg_Etape", "")
'---------- Definir la langue If p_Destinataire = "D" Then v_Langue = "FR" ' Directeur toujours en français v_To = xVarProf("Prof_DirecteurDestinataire", "") v_etapeDesc = "Reste à payer" v_NoMessage = 13 'Employé de SERTI
Else v_NoRepresentant = CStr(xVar2(gnd_FProp, "Repr_NotesID", "Prop_NoRepresentant", "")) v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) If v_Langue = "EN" Then v_etapeDesc = "Balance Due" Else v_etapeDesc = "Reste à payer" End If
'Verifier si le Repr est un employé de Serti ou fait parti d'une Equipe de Serti
v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "", True) v_EquipeTypeMembres = xSIRR_xVarEqui(v_NoEquipe, "Equi_TypeMembres", "", True)
If v_NoEquipe = "" Or (v_NoEquipe <> "" And v_EquipeTypeMembres = "1") Then
v_NoMessage = 13 'Employé de SERTI Else v_NoMessage = 12
End If
End If
Set nrtitem = New NotesRichTextItem (nd_temp, "MessageDescription")
If v_Etape = "R" Then v_etapefmt = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", v_NoMessage, v_Langue, "") & " " & v_etapeDesc
Else v_etapefmt = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", v_NoMessage, v_Langue, "") & " " & xSDSBB_xDescTabl(v_Etape, "Comm_Paiements" & v_Langue , False) '---message sur GDK
End If
Call nrtitem.AppendText (v_etapefmt) Call nrtitem.AddNewLine( 2 )
If Not (v_Message = "") Then Call nrtitem.AppendText (v_Message) Call nrtitem.AddNewLine( 2 ) End If
Call nd_temp.save(True, False)
Print "Exporter les commissions dans un fichier PDF"
' ------------------------------------------------ ' Exporter les commissions dans un fichier PDF ' ------------------------------------------------ Call FProp_acImprimer(p_Destinataire, "E", v_CheminPDF) If v_CheminPDF = "" Then Exit Sub End If
' Définir la langue d'impression If p_Destinataire = "R" Then
v_To = Evaluate(|"| & xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NotesId", "", True) & |"|)
v_CC = Evaluate(|"| & xVarSICT("EnvoyerCommPDF", "SICT_CC", "", True) & |"|) 'Noms CC existants dans Courriel Type
v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "", True)
If v_NoEquipe = "" Then
Call FProp_AjouterDestinataires ("Representant", v_NoRepresentant, v_To, v_CC)
Else Call FProp_AjouterDestinataires ("Equipe", v_NoEquipe, v_To, v_CC)
End If
End If
' ------------------------------ ' Envoyer le PDF au représentant ' ------------------------------
Set nd_SICT = SICT_ConstruireMessage(gnd_FProp, "EnvoyerCommPDF", v_Langue, v_To, v_CC, "", False, "") If nd_SICT Is Nothing Then ' Courriel type non sélectionné ou Erreur sur le courriel type. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage ("SI", 231, "", ""), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nrt_body = nd_SICT.GetFirstItem( "Body" )
Call nrtitem.AppendRTItem(nrt_body) Call nd_SICT.RemoveItem("Body") Call nrtitem.CopyItemToDocument(nd_SICT, "Body" )
Set nrt_body = nd_SICT.GetFirstItem( "Body" ) Call nrt_body.AddNewLine( 2 ) Set neo = nrt_body.embedobject(EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", v_CheminPDF)
Call nd_SICT.Send(False)
' ------------------------------------------------ ' Supprimer les fichiers local + autres nettoyages ' ------------------------------------------------ Kill v_CheminPDF
' -------------- ' MAJ historique ' -------------- If p_Destinataire = "D" Then Call SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FProp, "", "Action : Envoyer au directeur", gns_FProp.Commonusername, False) Else Call SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FProp, "", "Action : Envoyer au représentant", gns_FProp.Commonusername, False) End If
Call gnd_FProp.save(True, False)
'Réouvrir le document gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" 'Forcer read mode pour contourner problème de conflit causé par les doc locké gnuid_FProp.EditMode = False
Call gnuid_FProp.Close
Set na = gndb_FProp.GetAgent("A_Edit") Call na.Run(gnd_FProp.NoteId)
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FProp_acChangerStatut ' ----------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet demander le statut à changer pour la proposition ' ----------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim p_Statut As String Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours As Variant Dim v_CleTable As String Dim v_Message As String Dim v_Statut As String Dim p_Commentaire As String
' Initialisations Call FProp_Initialisations
' Effectuer les validations du masque de la proposition If gnuid_FProp.EditMode Then On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FProp.Save On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur End If
' Demander le statut désiré Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) v_CleTable = "StatProp_" nd_Box.DB_TableStatuts = v_CleTable & xLangue() nd_Box.DB_StatutActuel = xVar(gnd_FProp,"Prop_Statut","") v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 97, xLangue, "") If gnuiws_FProp.DialogBox("DB_Stat", True,True,False,False,False,False,_ v_Message, nd_Box,True,False,True) = False Then Exit Sub End If p_Statut = xVar(nd_Box,"DB_Statut","") p_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire", "") If Len(p_Statut) = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
'Validation 'Si 90-Commissioné ou 92-Completé sans commission If p_Statut = "90" Or p_Statut = "92" Then If Not SDSBT_BonsTravailFacture(gnd_FProp, a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Then If IsArray(a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours) Then
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FProp) nd_DB.DB_Message = xGDK_xMessage ("SDSCC", 14, "", xDescTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_" & xLangue, True)) nd_DB.DB_BonsTravail = a_NoBonsCommandeEnCours Call gnuiws_FProp.Dialogbox("DB_LBT", True, True, True, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, False)
Exit Sub End If End If End If
'Assigner le statut et sauvegarder If SDSPP_ChangerStatutProposition(gnd_FProp,p_Statut,p_Commentaire, "") Then gnd_FProp.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FProp.Close End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FProp, gc_Element_FProp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
