Sub FSucc_Initialisations If gns_FSucc Is Nothing Then Set gns_FSucc = New Notessession Set gndb_FSucc = gns_FSucc.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_FSucc = New Notesuiworkspace Set gnuid_FSucc = gnuiws_FSucc.CurrentDocument Set gnd_FSucc = gnuid_FSucc.Document End If End Sub

Function FSucc_hsNouveauModule
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim ndb_SDSBB As NotesDatabase Dim nv As Notesview Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_FTSearch As String Dim v_Code As String Dim v As Variant
Call FSucc_Initialisations Set nd_Prop = gndb_FSucc.GetDocumentByUnid(gnd_FSucc.ParentDocumentUNID)
' Sélectionner le produit à ajouter '--------------------------------------------- %REM Set ndb_SDSB = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDS Base") Call xnv(ndb_SDSB, "V_LProd13", nv) Set ndc = SISe_ndcSelectionnerDocuments("", "", SISe_PICKLIST, nv, |Prod_Description| & xLangue & _ | + " (" + Prod_Code + ")"|, xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 74, "", ""), "60") %END REM Set ndb_SDSBB = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDSBB") Call xnv(ndb_SDSBB, "V_Prod27", nv) Set ndc = SISe_ndcSelectionnerDocuments("", "", SISe_PICKLIST, nv, |Prod_DescProduit| & xLangue & _ | + " (" + Prod_CodeProduit + ")"|, xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 74, "", ""), "LG.00") ' LG.00 = logiciel SDS
' Verifier si l'utilisateur a fait un choix dans le dialogue ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Ajouter les modules sélectionnés ' ---------------------------------------------- Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing v_Code = xVar(nd, "Prod_CodeProduit", "") v = Evaluate(|@IsError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "v_Logi3"; @Text(@DocumentUniqueID) + ";| & v_Code & |"; 1))|, gnd_FSucc) If v(0) <> 1 Then ' 35 - Le module est déjà défini sur la succursale. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 35, "", v_Code), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else 'If xVar(nd, "Prod_NbUsagers", "") = "1" Then If xVar(nd, "Prod_TypeLogiciel", "") = "1" Then If xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Succ_UsagersVentes", 0) = 0 Then ' 35 - Le nombre d'utilisateurs SDS Ventes est requis pour ce logiciel. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 109, "", v_Code), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If ' Créer le module Call SDSLG_CreerLogiciel(nd_Prop, gnd_FSucc, v_Code, xVar(nd, "Prod_CleProduit", ""), 1, "CA") End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
' Mettre à jour la succursale gnd_FSucc.Logi_Code = "" Call gnuid_FSucc.Save
Call gnuiws_FSucc.ViewRefresh Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FSucc, gc_Element_FSucc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FSucc_hsRechercherService On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As Notesview Dim nd As NotesDocument
Call FSucc_Initialisations
'Verifier si on fait un recherche avec un code existant '----------------------------------------------------------------------- Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDSBB") Call xnv(ndb, "V_Prod25", nv) If xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Code", "") <> "" Then Set nd = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Code", ""), True) If nd Is Nothing Then Set nd = SISe_ndSelectionnerDocument("FIELD Prod_Description" & xLangue & " CONTAINS " & _ xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Code", ""), "", SISe_PICKLIST, nv, |Prod_DescProduit| & xLangue & | + " (" + Prod_CodeProduit + ")"|, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 75, "", ""), "") Else Set nd = SISe_ndSelectionnerDocument("", "", SISe_PICKLIST, nv, _ |Prod_DescProduit| & xLangue & | + " (" + Prod_CodeProduit + ")"|, xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 75, "", ""), "") End If Else Set nd = SISe_ndSelectionnerDocument("", "", SISe_PICKLIST, nv, _ |Prod_DescProduit| & xLangue & | + " (" + Prod_CodeProduit + ")"|, xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 75, "", ""), "") End If
' Verifier si l'utilisateur a fait un choix dans le dialogue ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- If nd Is Nothing Then Call gnuid_FSucc.GotoField("Serv_Code") Else Call gnd_FSucc.ReplaceItemValue("Serv_Code", xVar(nd, "Prod_CodeProduit", "")) Call FSucc_evExitingCode Call gnuid_FSucc.GotoField("Serv_Quantite") End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FSucc, gc_Element_FSucc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub FSucc_evExitingCode On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Code As String Dim v_CleProduit As String
Call FSucc_Initialisations
v_Code = xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Code", "")
v_CleProduit = xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(v_Code, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True)
If v_Code <> "" Then 'Retrouver la description correspondant au code d'équipement sur le formulaire et l'actualiser Call gnd_FSucc.ReplaceItemValue("Serv_Description" , xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit , "Prod_DescProduit" & xLangue, "", True))
'Si la quantité est vide, actualiser If xVar(gnd_FSucc,"Serv_Quantite","") = "" Then Call gnd_FSucc.ReplaceItemValue("Serv_Quantite" , xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit , "Prod_Quantite", "", True)) End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FSucc, gc_Element_FSucc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FSucc_evEnteringQuantite Call FSucc_Initialisations
Call gnuid_FSucc.SelectAll End Sub

Sub FSucc_hsAjouterService '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'ajouter un service de logiciel à la succursale. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim v_Code As String Dim v_CleProduit As String
' Initialisations Call FSucc_Initialisations Set nd_Prop = gndb_FSucc.GetDocumentByUnid(gnd_FSucc.ParentDocumentUNID)
v_Code = xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Code", "") v_CleProduit = xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(v_Code, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True)
If v_Code = "" Then ' 17 - Le code du service est obligatoire. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSP", 17, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Call gnuid_FSucc.GotoField("Serv_Code") Exit Sub End If If Cstr(xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Quantite", "")) = "" Then ' 15 - La quantité est obligatoire. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 15, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Call gnuid_FSucc.GotoField("Serv_Quantite") Exit Sub End If
' Créer le service If SDSSV_CreerService(nd_Prop, gnd_FSucc, v_Code, v_CleProduit, xVar(gnd_FSucc, "Serv_Quantite", ""), "1") Then ' Mettre à jour la succursale Call gnuid_FSucc.Fieldsettext("Serv_Code", "") Call gnuid_FSucc.Fieldsettext("Serv_Quantite", "") Call gnuid_FSucc.Save Call gnuid_FSucc.GotoField("Serv_Code")
Call gnuid_FSucc.Refresh End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FSucc, gc_Element_FSucc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSBB" ou "SDSBB" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSBB" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prod" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSBB As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSBB As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSDSBB As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSDSBB As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Cate_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Cate_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_TpPp_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_TpPp_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Prod_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prod_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_ProdCode_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_ProdCode_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées 'Dim gnv_Comp_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document 'Dim gnd_Comp_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Comp20_xSDSBB As NotesView Dim gnv_Depe20_xSDSBB As NotesView Dim gnd_Comm_xSDSBB As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Comm_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_Prix_xSDSBB As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prix_xSDSBB As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSBB = "SDSBB" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCate_xSDSBB = "Cate_CleCategorie" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCate_xSDSBB = "V_Cate20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemTpPp_xSDSBB = "TpPp_CleTypeProposition" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueTpPp_xSDSBB = "V_TpPp20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemProd_xSDSBB = "Prod_CleProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueProd_xSDSBB = "V_Prod20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemProdCode_xSDSBB = "Prod_CodeProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueProdCode_xSDSBB = "V_Prod21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche 'Const gc_NomItemCom_xSDSBB = "Prod_CleComposant" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) 'Const gc_NomVueComp_xSDSBB = "V_Comp20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueComm_xSDSBB = "V_Comm20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleComm_xSDSBB = "Comm_CodeCommissions" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomItemPrix_xSDSBB = "Prix_CleProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB = "V_Prix21"

Function xSDSBB_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSDSBB, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSDSBB, gndTabl_xSDSBB) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSBB_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSDSBB End Function

Function xSDSBB_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document. ' p_Cle = CodeProduit
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Call xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code = xVar(gnd_ProdCode_xSDSBB, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarTpPp(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document. ' p_Cle = CleTypeProposition
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Call xSDSBB_xndTpPp(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSDSBB_xVarTpPp = xVar(gnd_TpPp_xSDSBB, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSBB_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pNomVar As String, Byval pValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xndYYY) xSDSBB_xVarTabl = xVar(xSDSBB_xndTabl(pCle, pCache), pNomVar, pValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: 1 Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

Function xSDSBB_xndPrix(Byval p_CleProduit As Variant, Byval p_Devise As String, Byval p_Pays As String, _ Byval p_Province As String, Byval p_NbUsagers As Long) As NotesDocument Dim v_Cle(3) As String Dim nd_Prix As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Rechercher le document de prix correspondant aux paramètres v_Cle(0) = p_CleProduit v_Cle(1) = p_Devise v_Cle(2) = p_Pays v_Cle(3) = p_Province Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix)
'2eme lookup ici Do If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(3) <> "" Then v_Cle(3) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix) End If If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(2) <> "" Then v_Cle(2) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix) End If End If End If
' Rechercher le prix en fonction du nombre d'usagers Do Until p_NbUsagers <= xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Usagers", 99999) Set nd_Prix = gnv_Prix_xSDSBB.Getnextdocument(nd_Prix) Set ni = nd_Prix.GetFirstItem("Prix_Province") If xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_CleProduit", "") <> v_Cle(0) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Devise", "") <> v_Cle(1) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Pays", "") <> v_Cle(2) _ Or Not ni.contains(v_Cle(3)) Then Set nd_Prix = Nothing End If Loop Loop While nd_Prix Is Nothing And (v_Cle(2) <> "" Or v_Cle(3) <> "")
Set xSDSBB_xndPrix = nd_Prix End Function

Function xSDSBB_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xSDSBB_xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xSDSBB_xndTabl(p_Cle, True) Is Nothing) Then Set ni = gndTabl_xSDSBB.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSDSBB_xValeurExisteTabl = True End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarPrix(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Devise As String, _ Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Province As String, Byval p_NbUsagers As Long) As Double ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSBB_xVarPrix = xVar(xSDSBB_xndPrix(p_Cle, p_Devise, p_Pays, p_Province, p_NbUsagers), p_NomVar, 0) End Function

Function xSDSBB_xndTpPp(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié. ' p_Cle = CleTypeProposition

Function xSDSBB_xTypMLProd(Byval p_Cle As Variant,Byval p_VersionSDS As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Cette fonction permet d'extraire le type de média à utiliser pour le programme en question. 'Parametres: p_Cle ---> Nom du programme (logiciel) de SDS Base (LPDBMM) ' p_VersionSDS ----> La version SDS utilisée chez le client (Provient de CSA) 'Retourne le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS pour cette distribution 'pour ce programme '-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim nd_Logiciel As NotesDocument Dim a_LProdVersion As Variant Dim a_LProdTypeMedia As Variant Dim i As Integer
'Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = "Internet"
'Extraire la liste des versions et les médias qui y correspondent Set nd_Logiciel = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(p_Cle, True) a_LProdVersion = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaVersions") a_LProdTypeMedia = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaTypes")
If Isarray(a_LProdVersion) And Isarray(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then If Ubound(a_LProdVersion) <> Ubound(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then Exit Function End If
'Boucler jusqu'à ce qu'on ait trouvé l'emplacement de la version de SDS de notre client For i = Ubound(a_LProdVersion) To 0 Step -1 If p_VersionSDS >= a_LProdVersion(i) Then 'Retourner le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = a_LProdTypeMedia(i) Exit Function End If Next End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xComplTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_NoComplement As String, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xComplTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement, "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function SDSPPX_ndPrix(Byval p_CleProduit As String, Byval p_Devise As String, Byval p_Pays As String, _ Byval p_Province As String, Byval p_NbUsagers As Long) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document. Dim v_Cle(3) As String Dim nd_Prix As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Const c_NomVuePrix = "V_Prix21"
' Initialisations Call SDSPPX_Initialisations Call xSDSBB_Initialisations ' Rechercher le document de prix correspondant aux paramètres v_Cle(0) = p_CleProduit v_Cle(1) = p_Devise v_Cle(2) = p_Pays v_Cle(3) = p_Province Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, c_NomVuePrix, gnv_Prix21_SDSPPX, nd_Prix) Do If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(3) <> "" Then v_Cle(3) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, c_NomVuePrix, gnv_Prix21_SDSPPX, nd_Prix) End If If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(2) <> "" Then v_Cle(2) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, c_NomVuePrix, gnv_Prix21_SDSPPX, nd_Prix) End If End If End If
' Rechercher le prix en fonction du nombre d'usagers Do Until p_NbUsagers <= xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Usagers", 99999) Set nd_Prix = gnv_Prix21_SDSPPX.Getnextdocument(nd_Prix) Set ni = nd_Prix.GetFirstItem("Prix_Province") If xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_CleProduit", "") <> v_Cle(0) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Devise", "") <> v_Cle(1) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Pays", "") <> v_Cle(2) _ Or Not ni.contains(v_Cle(3)) Then Set nd_Prix = Nothing End If Loop Loop While nd_Prix Is Nothing And (v_Cle(2) <> "" Or v_Cle(3) <> "")
Set SDSPPX_ndPrix = nd_Prix End Function

Function SIIx_AppendVarString(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As String, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As String Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarString = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Variant Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVar = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Long Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a

Sub SIIx_AppendItemValue(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurAjouter As Variant Dim a_ValeurActuelle As Variant
' Formatter la valeur à ajouter If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then a_ValeurAjouter = Fulltrim(p_Valeur) If a_ValeurAjouter(0) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter End If Elseif p_Valeur = "" Then ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter Exit Sub Else a_ValeurAjouter = p_Valeur End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'item du document a_ValeurActuelle = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Isarray(a_ValeurActuelle) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, Arrayappend(a_ValeurActuelle, a_ValeurAjouter)) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_ValeurAjouter) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Date As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Date) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.Setanytime
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerDate = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_MajItem(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, Byval p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIIx_MajItem = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = Lbound(a_ValeurOrig) To Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then For i = Lbound(p_Valeur) To Ubound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next Elseif p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then If Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If Ubound(p_Valeur) <> Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) Then SIIx_MajItem = True Else For i = Lbound(p_Valeur) To Ubound(p_Valeur) If Cstr(p_Valeur(i)) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then SIIx_MajItem = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If Ubound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then SIIx_MajItem = True Elseif Cstr(p_Valeur(0)) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig) Then SIIx_MajItem = True End If End If Elseif Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then SIIx_MajItem = True Elseif Cstr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> Cstr(p_Valeur) Then SIIx_MajItem = True End If Elseif Cstr(p_Valeur) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau SIIx_MajItem = True End If
' Maj le champ If SIIx_MajItem Then If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Elseif p_Date Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AssignerHeure(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Heure As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Heure) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime If Isdate(p_Heure) Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Heure Call ndt.SetAnyDate
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerHeure = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSPP_SecSuperviseur(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoRepresentant As String Dim v_NoEquipe As String Dim v_NoSuperviseur As Variant Dim v_IdSuperviseur As String Dim i As Integer
pnd_Prop.Prop_NoSuperviseur = "" pnd_Prop.Prop_IdSuperviseur = ""
' Maj le superviseur ' ------------------------- v_NoRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", "") v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "", True) v_NoSuperviseur = xSIRR_xVarEqui(v_NoEquipe, "Equi_NoSuperviseur", "", True) If Not Isarray(v_NoSuperviseur) Then If v_NoSuperviseur = "" Then Exit Sub End If
v_NoSuperviseur = Evaluate(|" & v_NoSuperviseur & "|) End If
For i = Lbound(v_NoSuperviseur) To Ubound(v_NoSuperviseur) If v_NoSuperviseur(i) <> v_NoRepresentant Then v_IdSuperviseur = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoSuperviseur(i), "Repr_NotesId", "", True)
' ***** A modifier pour SDS Propositions II pnd_Prop.Prop_NoSuperviseur = v_NoSuperviseur pnd_Prop.Prop_IdSuperviseur = v_IdSuperviseur End If Next Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSPP_ChangerStatutProposition(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, p_Statut As String, p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de changer le statut de la proposition '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_changerstatut As String
Dim ws_Proposition As New Cl_proposition2
' Initialisations SDSPP_ChangerStatutProposition = False Call SDSPP_Initialisations
If p_UserName = "" Then p_Username = gns_SDSPP.Username End If
' Modifier le statut If Not SDSPP_AssignerStatut(pnd_Prop, p_Statut, False, p_Commentaire, p_UserName) Then Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la proposition aux statistiques 'Select Case p_Statut 'Case "95" : ' Call SDSST_AjouterProposition(pnd_Prop) ' Call SDSST_CalculerStatistiquesRep(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), Nothing) 'End Select If p_Statut = "90" Then Call SDSST_AjouterProposition(pnd_Prop) Call SDSST_CalculerStatistiquesRep(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", ""), Nothing) End If
'Commissioner/Terminer sans commissions If p_Statut = "90" Or p_Statut = "92" Then
If xSDSPP_xVarProp(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), "Prop_Statut", "", False)<> "95" Then
'Commentaire saisi par l'utilisateur dans le DialogBox, enregistré dans SI Temp Set nd_DB = SITp_ndTemp("SDSPP.acChangerStatut") nd_DB.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_DB.DB_Commentaire = p_Commentaire
Call nd_DB.Save(True, False)
v_changerstatut = ws_Proposition.Changerstatutsdspp(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), "95", p_UserName, nd_DB.UniversalId)
If v_changerstatut = "" Then Exit Function End If
End If
End If
SDSPP_ChangerStatutProposition = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSPP_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument,p_Commentaire As String, p_Principal As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_SendTo As Variant Dim v_CopyTo As Variant
Set nd_Prof = gndb_SDSPP.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") v_Langue = "FR"
' Envoyer le courriel en fonction du statut ' ------------------------------------------------------ v_Statut = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
Select Case v_Statut Case "12" : 'Remplacement "07" par "12": "Refusée" Req# 49322
Case "25", "55" : 'Soumises signatures & Installations v_SendTo = xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_DirecteurDestinataire", "") v_CopyTo = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdDirecteur", "")
Case "30", "60" : 'Acceptée signatures & Installation v_Langue = xSIRR_xVarRepr(CStr(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", "")), "Repr_Langue", "FR", True) 'v_SendTo = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdRepresentant", "") 'v_CopyTo = xVarArray(pnd_Prop,"Prop_IdSuperviseur")
Case Else : Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), LSI_Info(1), _ "Proposition : Statut " & v_Statut & " non supporté.", "", False) End Select
pnd_Prop.Temp_Comm = p_Commentaire ' Inclure le commentaire du changement de statut dans le courriel Call SICT_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Prop, "Statut" & v_Statut, v_Langue, v_SendTo, v_CopyTo, "", p_Principal, False, "")
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSPP_AssignerStatut(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument, p_Statut As String, _ p_DemanderCommentaire As Boolean, p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim na As NotesAgent
SDSPP_AssignerStatut = False Call SDSPP_Initialisations
' Demander le commentaire ' ------------------------------------- If p_DemanderCommentaire And Not gns_SDSPP.IsOnServer Then If Not SIHi_DemanderCommentaire(v_Commentaire, "", xGDK_xMessage("SI", 49, "", ""), False, False) Then Exit Function End If End If If p_Commentaire <> "" And v_Commentaire <> "" Then v_Commentaire = p_Commentaire & Chr(10) & v_Commentaire Else v_Commentaire = p_Commentaire & v_Commentaire End If
SDSPP_AssignerStatut = SDSPP_AssignerStatutProp(pnd_Prop, p_Statut, v_Commentaire, p_UserName) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "") & ";" & p_Statut, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSPP_SoumettreProposition(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument) As Integer On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations SDSPP_SoumettreProposition = False Call SDSPP_Initialisations
' Modifier le statut ' ----------------------- If Not SDSPP_AssignerStatut(pnd_Prop, "25", True, "", "") Then Exit Function End If
SDSPP_SoumettreProposition = True Exit Function

Function SDSPP_ImporterFacture(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, p_NoFacture As Long, p_NbDocuments As Integer) As Integer ' Valeur retournée: 0=OK, 1=Erreur devise, 2=Erreur générale On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim a_Cle(1) As Variant Dim v_DeviseTable As String
' Initialisations SDSPP_ImporterFacture = 2 ' Erreur générale p_NbDocuments = 0 Call SDSPP_Initialisations Set nd_Prof = gndb_SDSPP.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof")
' Validations If pnd_Prop Is Nothing Or p_NoFacture <= 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Effacer la facture, si présente Set nv = gndb_SDSPP.GetView("V_FaLi21") Call nv.Refresh a_Cle(0) = CStr(pnd_Prop.UniversalID) a_Cle(1) = p_NoFacture Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey(a_Cle, True) If ndc.Count > 0 Then Call ndc.RemoveAll(True) End If
' Extraire la facture du iSeries If Not SILSX_ndcImporterDonnees("Facture", "M3INV#=" & CStr(p_NoFacture) & _ " and (M3PCAT<30 or M3PCAT=40 or M3PCAT=56 or M3PCAT=57 or M3PCAT=69)", gndb_SDSPP, ndc) Then Exit Function End If If ndc.count = 0 Then Exit Function End If p_NbDocuments = ndc.Count
Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument v_DeviseTable = xGDK_xCompTabl(xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_Devise", ""), "ISO4217x" & xLangue, "1", False) If v_DeviseTable <> xVar(nd, "FaLi_DeviseDisgen", "") Then Call ndc.RemoveAll(True) SDSPP_ImporterFacture = 1 ' erreur devise Exit Function End If
' Créer les détails de la facture dans la proposition Call ndc.StampAll("$REF", pnd_Prop.UniversalId) Call ndc.StampAll("CleProposition", CStr(pnd_Prop.UniversalId)) SDSPP_ImporterFacture = 0 ' programme exécuté correctement (pas d'erreur) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", "") & " / " & p_NoFacture, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSPP_AssignerSecurite(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument) ' p_Auteur = False --> Personne, True --> Représentant+Autorisés On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Lecteur As String Dim v_Auteur As String Dim i As Integer Redim a_Items(3) As String Redim a_Valeurs(3) As Variant
' Maj le superviseur ' ------------------------- Call SDSPP_SecSuperviseur(pnd_Prop)
' Assigner la sécurité (Lecteur / Auteur) ' --------------------------------------------------- v_Lecteur = xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Lecteur", ";") v_Auteur = xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Auteur", ";") Call SDSPP_SecAssignerSec(pnd_Prop)
If xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Lecteur", ";") <> v_Lecteur Then a_Items(i) = "Lecteur" a_Valeurs(i) = xVarArray(pnd_Prop, "Lecteur") i = i + 1 End If
If xVarImplode(pnd_Prop, "Auteur", ";") <> v_Auteur Then a_Items(i) = "Auteur" a_Valeurs(i) = xVarArray(pnd_Prop, "Auteur") i = i + 1 End If
' Assigner les changements aux documents réponse ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- If i > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_Items(i) As String Redim Preserve a_Valeurs(i) As Variant Call SIHr_RemplacerValeur(pnd_Prop, a_Items, a_Valeurs, "") End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSPP_SecAssignerSec(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_IdRepresentant As String Dim v_IdSuperviseur As String Dim v_Statut As String Redim a_Lecteurs(99) As String Dim v_NoLecteur As Integer Redim a_Auteurs(99) As String Dim v_NoAuteur As Integer Dim a As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
v_IdRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdRepresentant", "") v_IdSuperviseur = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_IdSuperviseur", "") v_Statut = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_Statut", "")
' Calculer la sécurité ' --------------------------- If v_Statut < "25" Or v_Statut = "94" Then Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", "") Elseif v_Statut = "25" Then Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "[Directeur]") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", "") Else Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", Evaluate(|@Trim("| & v_IdRepresentant & |":"| & v_IdSuperviseur & |":"[Directeur]")|)) End If %REM Select Case v_Statut Case "25": Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "[Directeur]") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", "") Case "45": Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", Evaluate(|@Trim("| & v_IdRepresentant & |":"| & v_IdSuperviseur & |":"[Directeur]")|)) Case "95": Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", Evaluate(|@Trim("| & v_IdRepresentant & |":"| & v_IdSuperviseur & |":"[Directeur]")|)) Case Else: Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Auteur", "") Call pnd_Prop.ReplaceItemValue("Lecteur", "") End Select %END REM Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSPP_AssignerStatutProp(pnd_Prop As Notesdocument, p_Statut As String, _ p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Lang As String
SDSPP_AssignerStatutProp = False Call SDSPP_Initialisations v_Lang = xVar(pnd_Prop,"Prop_Langue","")
If p_UserName = "" Then p_Username = gns_SDSPP.Username End If
' Ajouter le commentaire à l'historique ' -------------------------------------------------- If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Prop, p_Statut & "-" & xDescTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_FR", True), _ p_Commentaire, p_UserName, False) Then Exit Function End If
' Assigner le nouveau statut ' ------------------------------------ pnd_Prop.Prop_Statut = p_Statut pnd_Prop.Prop_StatutDate = Now pnd_Prop.Prop_StatutIcone = xIcnTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_FR", True) pnd_Prop.Prop_StatutDescFR = p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_FR", True) pnd_Prop.Prop_StatutDescEN = p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_EN", True)
' Assigner le masque d'affichage Select Case p_Statut Case "25", "45": pnd_Prop.Form = "F_Prop2" Case Else: pnd_Prop.Form = "F_Prop" End Select
' Mettre à jour l'historique de la proposition ' --------------------------------------------------------- Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Prop)
' Modifier les accès (sécurité) ' -------------------------------------- Call SDSPP_AssignerSecurite(pnd_Prop)
' Gérer le workflow ' ------------------------ pnd_Prop.Prop_ClientNom = Evaluate({@If(!@IsNull(Prop_ClientNom);Prop_ClientNom;Prop_ClientNomInterne)}, pnd_Prop)
If xComplTabl(p_Statut, "StatProp_FR", "1", True) = "1" Then Call SDSPP_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Prop, p_Commentaire, p_UserName) End If
SDSPP_AssignerStatutProp = True Exit Function
GererErreur: End Function
Sub SDSPP_Initialisations If gns_SDSPP Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSPP = New Notessession Set gndb_SDSPP = gns_SDSPP.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function SDSPP_ChangerRepresentant(pnd_Prop As NotesDocument, pnd_Rep As NotesDocument) As Boolean 'Cette Fonction permet de changer le représentant d'une proposition. 'Parametres: pnd: L'objet document de la proposition ' p_NoRep: Le numéro du nouveau représentant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NoRepresentant As String Dim v_NomRepresentantPrec As String Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_NoEquipe As String Dim v_CommissionsRepresentant As String Dim v_NoDirecteur As String Dim nd_Dir As NotesDocument Dim v_Prof_DirCommissionsDir As String
' Initialisations SDSPP_ChangerRepresentant = False Call SDSPP_Initialisations v_Maj = False
' Changer le représentant '---------------------------------- v_NoRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Rep, "BASALE", "") If v_NoRepresentant <> xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoRepresentant", 0) Then v_NomRepresentantPrec = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NomRepresentant", "")
pnd_Prop.Prop_NoRepresentant = v_NoRepresentant pnd_Prop.Prop_IdRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Rep, "Repr_NotesId", "") pnd_Prop.Prop_NomRepresentant = xVar(pnd_Rep, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") v_Maj = True
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Prop, "Action : " & _ "Représentant remplaçé / Sales rep. replaced (" & v_NomRepresentantPrec & ")", "", "", False) End If
Set ni = xni(pnd_Rep, "Repr_SDSPropositions", "") If ni.Contains("XC") Then v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsRepresentant", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsDirecteur", "", False) Or v_Maj ElseIf ni.Contains("DIR") Then v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsRepresentant", xSIRR_xVarComm_Repr(v_NoRepresentant, xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_ClientPays", ""), xVar(pnd_Prop, _ "Prop_ClientProvince", ""), "Comm_CodeCommissions", ""), False) Or v_Maj v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsDirecteur", "", False) Or v_Maj Else ' Le représentant doit avoir une table de commissions v_NoEquipe = xSIRR_xVarRepr(v_NoRepresentant, "Repr_NoEquipe", "0", True) If v_NoEquipe = "0" Then v_CommissionsRepresentant = xSIRR_xVarComm_Repr(v_NoRepresentant, xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_ClientPays", ""), xVar(pnd_Prop, _ "Prop_ClientProvince", ""), "Comm_CodeCommissions", "") Else v_CommissionsRepresentant = xSIRR_xVarComm_Equi(v_NoEquipe, xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_ClientPays", ""), xVar(pnd_Prop, _ "Prop_ClientProvince", ""), "Comm_CodeCommissions", "") End If ' Le représentant doit avoir une table de commissions If v_CommissionsRepresentant <> "" Then v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsRepresentant", v_CommissionsRepresentant, False) Or v_Maj v_NoDirecteur = xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoDirecteur", "") Set nd_Dir = xSIRR_xndRepr(v_NoDirecteur, True) v_Prof_DirCommissionsDir = xSDSPP_xVarProf("Prof_DirCommissionsDir", "") v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsDirecteur", xVar(nd_Dir, "Repr_DirCommissionsDir_SS", v_Prof_DirCommissionsDir), False) Or v_Maj Else v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsRepresentant", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj =SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Prop, "Prop_CommissionsDirecteur", "", False) Or v_Maj End If End If
If v_Maj Then ' Modifier les accès (sécurité) ' -------------------------------------- Call SDSPP_AssignerSecurite(pnd_Prop)
' Mettre à jour l'historique de la proposition ' --------------------------------------------------------- Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Prop)
SDSPP_ChangerRepresentant = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), _ xVar(pnd_Prop, "Prop_NoProposition", ""), False) Exit Function
End Function

Function SDSPP_ImporterFactures(p_NoProposition As String, p_NoFactures As String) As String ' Valeur retournée: Liste de codes 0=OK, 1=Erreur devise, 2=Erreur générale par facture On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim a_NoFactures As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_NbDocuments As Integer Dim v_Erreur As String
SDSPP_ImporterFactures = "E" Call SDSPP_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP)
If p_NoProposition = "" Or p_NoFactures = "" Then Exit Function End If
Set nv = gndb_SDSPP.GetView("V_Prop20") Call nv.Refresh Set nd_Prop = nv.GetDocumentByKey(p_NoProposition, True) If nd_Prop Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
a_NoFactures = Split(p_NoFactures, ";") ReDim a_Resultats(UBound(a_NoFactures)) As String For i = 0 To UBound(a_NoFactures) a_Resultats(i) = CStr(SDSPP_ImporterFacture(nd_Prop, CLng(a_NoFactures(i)), v_NbDocuments))
Select Case a_Resultats(i) Case "0": v_Erreur = "OK" Case "1": v_Erreur = "Erreur de devise" Case Else: v_Erreur = "Erreur générale" End Select Call SIGE_AjouterLog("P" & p_NoProposition & " F" & a_NoFactures(i) & " - " & v_Erreur & " : " & CStr(v_NbDocuments) & " produits importés.", 0 , 0, False) Next
SDSPP_ImporterFactures = Implode(a_Resultats, ";") Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSPP, gc_Element_SDSPP, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NoProposition & " / " & p_NoFactures, False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSP" ou "SDSP" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSP" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prop" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSPP As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSPP As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Prop_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prop_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Site_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site21_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_MOpt_xSDSPP As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_MOpt_xSDSPP As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSPP = "SDSPP" ' Inscrire le nom de la base de documents, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomVueProp_xSDSPP = "V_Prop20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleProp_xSDSPP = "Prop_NoProposition" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite_xSDSPP = "V_Site20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleSite_xSDSPP = "Site_NoSite" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite21_xSDSPP = "V_Site21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemMOpt_xSDSPP = "MOpt_Code" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueMOpt_xSDSPP = "V_MOpti20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = W32_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AccesAuteur(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_AccessLevel As Integer Dim a_UserNamesList As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Vérifier l'accès à la base de documents Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase v_AccessLevel = ndb.CurrentAccessLevel
If v_AccessLevel < ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = False Elseif v_AccessLevel > ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Else ' Vérifier l'accès au document a_UserNamesList = Evaluate("@Usernameslist") a_Items = pnd.Items For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Items) Set ni = a_Items(i) If ni.IsAuthors() Then For j = 0 To Ubound(a_UserNamesList) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(ni.Values, a_UserNamesList(j))) Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Exit Function End If Next End If Next End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, ByVal p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean ' Vérifie si la valeur de l'item p_NomItem est égale à p_Valeur On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ValeurDifferente As Boolean Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = False v_ValeurDifferente = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = LBound(a_ValeurOrig) To UBound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next ElseIf p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If UBound(p_Valeur) <> UBound(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Else For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) If CStr(p_Valeur(i)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If UBound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur(0)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If End If ElseIf IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If UBound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> CStr(p_Valeur) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau v_ValeurDifferente = True End If
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = Not v_ValeurDifferente Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AddedToFile(pnd As NotesDocument) As String
Dim db As String Dim s As String Dim ns As Integer
With pnd.ParentDatabase db = String$(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, .Server, .FilePath, db End With
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen db$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
Dim hNT As Long Dim T(1) As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, Clng("&H" & pnd.NoteID), 0, hNT If Not hNT = 0 Then SINAPI_NSFNoteGetInfo hNT, 13, T(0) SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT s = Space(80) SINAPI_ConvertTIMEDATEToText 0, 0, T(0), s, 80, ns SIND_AddedToFile = Left$(s, ns) End If
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Function
